facts.fact: ARCEP Bénin states a bilateral protocol applying the ECOWAS regional roaming regulation was signed in Dakar on 12 December 2025 between Benin and Senegal (and between Togo and Senegal).

ARCEP Bénin, ARCEP Togo and ARTP Senegal officially launched free roaming between the three countries in Lomé on 24 April 2026; data in roaming fell from 10,000 to 2 FCFA per MB and call receipt is free for the first 30 days.

systems.owner: ARCEP Bénin, ARCEP Togo, ARTP Senegal
